item.reds_nether_spellbooks.combustion_r: When attacked, emit a damaging wave of fire
item.reds_nether_spellbooks.treacherous_: Makes your Fire Spell Damage inflict Treacherous Fire and doubles it when the is under 50% health
item.reds_nether_spellbooks.withered_con: Makes your Summons inflict up to 4 stacks of Wither onto their targets
item.reds_nether_spellbooks.soul_burn_ta: Makes your Fire Spell Damage inflict Soul Fire and add stacks of Soul Burn
spell.reds_nether_spellbooks.pyroclast_d: Hold to unleash a barrage of 4 daggers made out of pyroclast in a wide angle, igniting any creature they hit
spell.reds_nether_spellbooks.summon_blaz: Cast to conjure Blazes that will follow,protect and fight for you
spell.reds_nether_spellbooks.ecto_bomb.g: Launch a bomb made from souls, exploding on impact and leaving a field of soul fire where it lands
spell.reds_nether_spellbooks.phasmo_bolt: Shot a powerful ecto shard forward that pierces both block and enemies and damages creatures that it phases thorough
spell.reds_nether_spellbooks.soulfire_ra: Fires a beam of soul fire, dealing low damage but reducing healing to the creature it hit
spell.reds_nether_spellbooks.summon_bans: Cast to conjure Banshees that will follow,protect and fight for you
spell.reds_nether_spellbooks.summon_vess: Cast to conjure Vessels that will follow,protect and fight for you
spell.reds_nether_spellbooks.wraithing_w: Imbue yourself with necrotic energy, healing your wounds when receiving damage at the cost of decreasing your movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, and cast time reduction by 0.025% each time up to 50%
spell.reds_nether_spellbooks.black_icicl: Fire a piercing bolt of withering cold energy in the form of an icicle, inflicting a Cryonecrosis to those it pierces
spell.reds_nether_spellbooks.ebony_shatt: Punch a creature to freeze its defenses and shatter them, rendering them. Rendered creatures have reduced armor. Creatures frozen enough have their resistance to Ice Spell Damage reduced
